title: Muryar Shiru ta Kwarin
intro: Koma baya ga wani babban mutum wanda a da ya sami wani abin mamaki mai rai a matsayin gwaji. Girman kai da taurin kai sun tabbatar da makomarsu. Za ku iya bin diddigin labarin ku gano abin da ya faru a wannan gagarumin lokaci na juyin juya hali?
clues: An aiko ni a matsayin jarabawar allahntaka ga mutane masu ƙarfi da aka san su da ƙarfi da rashin biyayya.
Ni abin al'ajabi ne na musamman—irina ba ta taɓa bayyana a cikinsu ba.
Na raba ruwan sha daga rijiya da mutanena a wasu ranaku daban-daban.
An yi musu gargaɗi cewa duk wani lahani da aka yi mini zai kawo hukunci cikin sauri.
Mafi ƙarfin hali daga cikinsu ya yi watsi da gargaɗin ya kuma danne ni.
Bayan mutuwata, wata ƙara mai ƙarfi daga sama ta lalata dukkan mutanena.

trial.label: Kaddarata Ta
options: An yi wa rauni rauni kuma an kashe shi
An yanka shi a matsayin hadaya
An kiyaye shi ta hanyar ambaliyar ruwa mai girma
An kawo shi cikin sauri a cikin masarauta
trial.answer: An yi wa rauni rauni kuma an kashe shi

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An lalata shi da ihu ɗaya kawai
An nutsar da shi cikin ambaliyar ruwa mai girma
An ƙone ta da ruwan duwatsu
Iska mai ƙarfi ta buge shi
outcome.answer: An lalata shi da ihu ɗaya kawai

verse: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]. (54:29)
